postMergeVerificationFixes.resolution: nestedCallV1Schema.argumentsCommitment widened from 64-hex digest to z.string().min(1): the field stores the ledger's argument commitment, which is the plain digest under legacy admission and the signed v1:keyId:mac envelope under audit-mode admission (EffectAdmissionPolicy latches AUDIT once a store holds receipts). Binding semantics unchanged: stored commitment must equal the ledger-computed commitment at reattach.

Fixture ledgers now run with audit.effectsV1 enabled plus a deterministic injected authenticator (fixed 32-byte key + keyId), because main's EffectAdmissionPolicy disables admissions on any store with existing toolEffect receipts unless the matching flag is enabled, and signed commitments must match across the crash child / reopening parent. Exercises real HMAC; not OS custody. ROUND-2b: Exports m12EffectAuthenticator() so a reopening Service can share the deterministic custody key (M12_EFFECT_KEY/M12_EFFECT_KEY_ID) already used by m12Ledger and the crash child.

Flag assertion switched to toMatchObject (main added tools.deferredV1; the three M12 flags are still asserted registered and default-off). The 64-admitted/65th-denied boundary tests restored verbatim at default maxCalls after review: wall-clock deadline exposure under host contention is retained as real evidence, not masked.

Registry-change fixture now performs a real toolSchemas.repository_read schema extension (rebuilt registry -> different schemaDigest -> valid redisclosure -> REPLAY_DIVERGED) instead of a version bump; version is literal 1 and disclosure validates digest(parameters)===schemaDigest. Crash-fixture spawn timeout raised 10s->60s; non-subject deadlines relaxed (1200ms->default, 600ms->8000ms keeps expiry-in-test premise).
Same real-schema-change redisclosure fixture as replay-v3; m12Ledger for the populated-store construction.

Definition-change fixture now mutates schemaDigest (the ledger's dedup binding under merged semantics) rather than version; both ledgers run via m12Ledger so the conflict attributes to the definition change, not a commitment-scheme mismatch.

m12Ledger for the populated-store admits; crash timeout raised 10s->60s. ROUND-2b: The reopened Service now carries the producing deployment's effect configuration (audit.effectsV1 + the deterministic fixture authenticator) so programs.recover() commitment-matching sees the same signed scheme it wrote; M12 program flags stay default-off — the disable-under-test is the program lane, not effect custody. The unrelated/unlinked M02 receipts now assert the merged generic recovery semantic: open dispatches reconcile to UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_OUTCOME (rolled_back), retained and never executed, rather than frozen byte-equal.
Removed the now-dead local sameOwner helper (main's matchesInvocation does field-wise owner comparison; tool-programs.ts keeps its own copy for program-owner checks).

Fixture parity: the Service enables audit.effectsV1 + security.authorityV1 but injected no authenticator, so the flagged ledger rejected every admission with EFFECT_KEY_UNAVAILABLE by design (production injects OS-key custody via effect-service.ts). testEffectAuthenticator() now supplies real HMAC custody for the flagged fixture, matching main's own service-level suites.
